paper_title: Stellar Basins of Gravitationally Bound Particles
notes: Paper presents a new 'Solar basin' limit on the axion-electron coupling g_aee (Fig. 3), recast from DM axion absorption line searches (XENON1T, LUX, PandaX-II) independent of DM assumptions. Data points are approximate readings from the conservative-limit blue curve in Fig. 3, spanning roughly m~1-100 keV. The stellar-basin density is a source rather than an assumed halo, so no dm_density is set. Values are approximate since extracted from a plot; the minimum coupling reached is ~9e-14 near ~10-20 keV. This is NOT the DM density assumption experiment though the recast uses rho_DM in Eq.28 for the mapping. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.7, 37)) | Vision: Traced the thick solid blue 'conservative/fiducial' Solar Axion Basin exclusion boundary from Fig. 3, which is the DM-independent recast limit. Curve shows a sharp drop near ~0.7 keV, a broad minimum near g_aee ~8e-13 in the 1-10 keV range, and a steep rise above ~10 keV.
